title: Austin's election calendar from here
subtitle: Early voting opens Monday after a weekend of candidate events
alt: Timeline of the November election from KVUE and KXAN: on October 18, more than 300 people heard Council candidates from Districts 1, 3, 5 and 9 at a Central Texas Interfaith forum; early voting opens October 19 and runs through October 30; Election Day is Tuesday, November 3.
